entries.title: Psalms 26:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David.>> Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in Jehovah without wavering.

entries.title: Psalms 26:2
segments: Examine me, O Jehovah, and prove me; Try my heart and my mind.

entries.title: Psalms 26:3
segments: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes; And I have walked in thy truth.

entries.title: Psalms 26:4
segments: I have not sat with men of falsehood; Neither will I go in with dissemblers.

entries.title: Psalms 26:5
segments: I hate the assembly of evil-doers, And will not sit with the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 26:6
segments: I will wash my hands in innocency: So will I compass thine altar, O Jehovah;

entries.title: Psalms 26:7
segments: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, And tell of all thy wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 26:8
segments: Jehovah, I love the habitation of thy house, And the place where thy glory dwelleth.

entries.title: Psalms 26:9
segments: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood;

entries.title: Psalms 26:10
segments: In whose hands is wickedness, And their right hand is full of bribes.

entries.title: Psalms 26:11
segments: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

entries.title: Psalms 26:12
segments: My foot standeth in an even place: In the congregations will I bless Jehovah.
